description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder and ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator interfaces in Orleans.Hosting, enabling configuration of Azure storage options such as queue streams and blob lease providers.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure Azure streaming and lease provider options in Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Queue persistent streams with specified configuration.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Overload to configure Azure Queue streams with default settings using options.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Configures the silo to use an Azure Blob Lease provider with custom options.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureBlobLeaseProviderServices
methods.description: Sets up services related to Azure Blob Lease provider, including validation and activation.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Configures the stream configurator to use Azure Blob Lease provider with specified options.
